objective: Evaluate newly published GPT-6 and cross-provider benchmark evidence, then update Chohogi model policy to reflect workload-specific evidence without making unsupported quality or runtime availability claims.
requested: compare current OpenAI model claims with independent and non-OpenAI evaluation evidence
update Chohogi global model selection policy and its executable profile declarations to reflect that evidence
preserve per-project Model Session Policy confirmation and user overrides
excluded: inspect credentials, private configuration, session data, or infer runtime catalog availability
automatically change provider/model choice for existing projects without a confirmed session profile
treat vendor benchmark claims as general proof of quality

requestedItems.description: Summarize dated, task-specific model performance and cost evidence from OpenAI, other providers, and independent evaluations.
Update global Chohogi model policy/profile behavior to use evidence scoped by workload and preserve human project confirmation.

acceptance.description: A durable benchmark evidence note records source, date, workload, effort/harness, cost basis, and limits.
The active policy reflects the new evidence and the project-specific confirmation/override contract.
Two independent read-only reviewers check source claims and policy/tool consistency; findings are resolved or recorded.
Relevant non-test policy and semantic checks pass, with limits reported.
